ArmedLoops.note: Three loops inside the composer popover the ⟳ chip opens: prompts line-clamped to 2, humanised cadence ('every 15 minutes', 'every 2 hours'), deterministic 'next in 4m/2h' from the pinned nowMs, underlined fire-count links, NATIVE badges, and a cleared loop at 60% with its delete action withdrawn.

ArmANewLoop.note: Empty loops -> the panel opens straight into the composer: textarea, Interval/Cron segmented pair, cadence input, Cancel/Arm loop with Arm disabled until a prompt exists.

PendingWrite.note: pendingWrite disables the add and per-row delete controls; rows keep showing the last confirmed mirror state.
